headline: Fitch Ratings Upgrades Dominican Republic Sovereign Credit Rating to BB
summary: Fitch Ratings raised the Dominican Republic's long-term sovereign credit rating to BB from BB- while maintaining a stable outlook, citing solid macroeconomic fundamentals and resilient fiscal and external accounts.
why: Sovereign credit upgrades lower borrowing costs for governments and improve the investment climate for international capital entering domestic markets.

impacts.name: Dominican Republic
impacts.why: A credit rating upgrade improves national creditworthiness and can drive foreign capital inflows.
